title: Jarum Jala Merah Jambu
genre: 1960s Malay orkes Melayu (classic accordion-and-suling dance orchestra with gendang)
subject: Pak Din mends his torn cast net on the jetty with his wife's pink sewing thread because the nylon ran out, and the other fishermen will not stop laughing
caption: Malay orkes Melayu, classic dance-orchestra sub-style with call-and-response chorus. Button accordion leading the melody, bamboo suling flute doubling in the upper octave, tabla and gendang playing a driving two-beat dance pattern, mandolin strumming offbeats, upright bass. Bright live dance-hall sound, spring reverb, band recorded together. Male tenor lead, mid-high register, cheerful teasing delivery, group chorus answering each chorus line. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 124 BPM, G major. Teasing, cheerful, danceable mood. No electric guitar, no drum machine, no koplo kendang programming, no synth, no autotune, no rap, no trap hi-hats.
lyrics:
[Intro - accordion, suling, tabla]

[Verse 1]
Pak Din di jeti, jala koyak lima lubang
Nilon dah habis, kedai dah tutup
Dalam kocek ada benang jahit isteri
Warna merah jambu, jarum jala dipegang

[Pre-Chorus]
Kawan-kawan gelak, Pak Din buat tak dengar
Tampal satu, tampal dua

[Chorus]
Jala merah jambu, hei jangan gelak
Ikan tak kisah warna, asal masuk
Jala merah jambu, hei jangan gelak
Esok pagi kita tengok siapa untung

[Verse 2]
Tauke bot lalu, jeling dari jauh
Kata jala kau macam kain Kak Jah
Pak Din jawab, ini isteri yang jahit
Kuat sampai ke subuh, tak putus-putus

[Pre-Chorus]
Budak-budak kampung berhenti menjenguk
Seorang tanya, boleh pinjam benang?

[Chorus]
Jala merah jambu, hei dah tak gelak?
Ikan penuh bakul, siapa gelak sekarang
Jala merah jambu, hei jangan lupa
Semua nak benang merah jambu

[Chorus]
Jala merah jambu, hei kita menari
Ikan pun menari dalam jala wangi
Jala merah jambu, hei kita menari
Pak Din sebelah kanan, isteri sebelah kiri

[Outro - suling and accordion]
Merah jambu, merah jambu
Tampal lagi, tampal lagi
